Drag to mark X's: the X button and Answer now place X's with drags instead of tapping each cell. A full row, column, or the 8 cells around a cat go on in one swipe. Every drag starts on an empty cell and only crosses cells that should be X'd or already are, so existing X's are never cleared.

Verification: after marking, the board is re-read; any X placed by mistake is cleared (a drag starting on that X) and any missed cell is re-marked, up to 3 rounds. Your own X's are left alone. Answer does the same check between rounds.

Install: download **MeowSolver-v2.6.apk** below, then follow the Setup steps in the README. Android 11+. If Android refuses to update over an older version, uninstall the old app first.

Source: see README for build steps.
